annotations.title: Get component in a brand style

description: Returns one component's source together with the tokens of a brand style, step-by-step instructions for mapping the component's colours, fonts and radii onto that style, and the colour values the component uses today. Use it instead of get_component when the result should match a specific brand. The server does not rewrite the code; you apply the mapping. Same premium rule as get_component.

name.description: Component name as listed by list_components, e.g. 'GradientHeroSection'.

style.description: Style slug exactly as listed by list_styles.

name: get_component_styled
title: Get component in a brand style
